name: AWS VPC and Network Security Assessment
description: Security assessment of AWS networking configurations. Covers VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, VPC peering, Transit Gateway, VPN, PrivateLink, flow logs, and network segmentation within AWS environments.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to AWS VPC and network security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands AWS VPC architecture and network security primitives
evidence: Can explain VPCs, subnets, route tables, and internet/NAT gateways
Understands the difference between security groups and NACLs
Familiar with VPC flow logs and their use in security monitoring

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews AWS network configurations under supervision using established tooling
evidence: Enumerates VPC configurations and security group rules with guidance
Identifies overly permissive security group rules using lab checklists
Documents network security findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses AWS network architecture and segmentation
evidence: Independently reviews network segmentation across multi-VPC environments
Identifies lateral movement risks through VPC peering and Transit Gateway misconfigurations
Analyzes VPC flow logs for security insights

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex multi-region network assessments; develops automated network analysis tooling
evidence: Assesses complex hub-and-spoke and Transit Gateway architectures
Develops tooling for automated security group and network path analysis
Reviews network assessment work of junior analysts
Evaluates hybrid connectivity (VPN, Direct Connect) security

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab AWS network assessment methodology; publishes network security research
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's AWS network security assessment framework
Published research on AWS network security bypass or segmentation failures
Trains teams on advanced AWS network security assessment
Recognized as authority on cloud network architecture security

assessment_methods.description: Assess a multi-VPC AWS environment and identify all network segmentation weaknesses and lateral movement paths
Review network security findings and architecture diagrams from recent AWS assessments

cis: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v5.0.0 - Section 5 Networking
